question.questionText: The seller asked ________ to give feedback on the appearance and the quality of the new merchandise.

  • shopper (singular noun): This is the singular noun form, meaning one person who shops. However, the context suggests that feedback is being requested from more than one person, so the plural form is more appropriate.

  • signifies (verb): Verb (động từ): means 'to be a sign of' or 'to indicate'.
  • significant (adjective): Adjective (tính từ): means 'important' or 'meaningful'.
  • significance (noun): Noun (danh từ): means 'importance' or 'meaning'.
  • significantly (adverb): Adverb (trạng từ): means 'in an important way' or 'considerably'.
